provenance.source_url_or_construction_note: Authentic historical failure: nodejs/node GitHub Actions run 22532700362, job/check run 65274588187 (workflow 'Test macOS', job 'test-macOS', event pull_request, completed 2026-03-01T01:56:34Z) at https://github.com/nodejs/node/actions/runs/22532700362/job/65274588187 . raw.log is the verbatim GitHub Check Run failure annotation recorded against test/parallel/test-debugger-exceptions.js; the full Actions job log is no longer retrievable (API returns HTTP 410, log retention expired) and was not reconstructed. REVISION IDENTITY -- Actual executed revision: a GitHub ephemeral pull-request merge revision (refs/pull/65153/merge), whose exact merge SHA is NO LONGER RECOVERABLE; the workflow used actions/checkout with no explicit ref, so a pull_request event checks out that merge tree rather than the pull-request head, and the ref has since been regenerated for a newer head (it now resolves to 929712c2e0bdb098010be4686c552c7946470d44). Recovery was attempted through the workflow-run payload (head_sha, head_commit.id, head_commit.tree_id), the check-run record, and the commit check-suites, and every field reports only the pull-request head; no GitHub primary metadata retains the historical merge SHA. Recoverable repository revision, and the value declared in repository-manifest.json: 3c08a48c24c39ad4dee6d95c5c800246f300525e, the run head commit. Relationship: every frozen Physical Universe repository member is independently proven byte-equivalent to the actual executed merge state, because 3c08a48c24c39ad4dee6d95c5c800246f300525e changes only deps/googletest paths, its parent 6964b539806e3b2103dd6b65572287b8a615f5d3 landed on main at committer date 2026-02-28T14:40:38Z, and no commit touching any manifest-declared member has a committer date between that time and the run start; the two era commits that touch declared members, 76ba280051824dd9b80a4eb0ea38a613282df8e5 and 4f04a36bba7f4970d0c7f1d875896fa480dfed45, were both confirmed ancestors of the declared revision. Byte equivalence for the declared members is therefore established, while the executed revision identity itself remains unrecoverable; the declared revision must not be read as the executed revision. Related upstream flaky-test tracking issue: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/61762 (the console excerpt in its body names no test file and is not used as this Case's failure artifact). Curator-only causal verification source, deliberately absent from Physical Artifacts: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/62055 .
